                                                                                
 Usage: agentarts invoke [OPTIONS] {payload}                                    
                                                                                
 Invoke agent with JSON payload.                                                
                                                                                
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    payload      <str>  JSON payload to send to the agent (e.g.,            │
│                          '{"message": "hello"}')                             │
│                          [required]                                          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --agent                  -a       <str>  Agent name (uses default if not     │
│                                          specified for cloud mode)           │
│ --mode                   -m       <str>  Invoke mode: 'local' for Docker     │
│                                          container, 'cloud' for AgentArts    │
│                                          runtime (default)                   │
│                                          [default: cloud]                    │
│ --region                 -r       <str>  Huawei Cloud region (for cloud      │
│                                          mode)                               │
│ --port                   -p       <int>  Local port (for local mode,         │
│                                          default: 8080)                      │
│ --endpoint               -e       <str>  Endpoint name                       │
│ --session                -s       <str>  Session ID for stateful agents      │
│ --bearer-token           -bt      <str>  Bearer token for authentication     │
│ --timeout                         <int>  Request timeout in seconds          │
│                                          (default: 900)                      │
│                                          [default: 900]                      │
│ --skip-ssl-verification  -k              Skip SSL certificate verification   │
│ --user-id                -u       <str>  User ID for OAuth2 outbound         │
│                                          credentials                         │
│ --custom-path                     <str>  Custom path appended to             │
│                                          /invocations (e.g., 'stream' ->     │
│                                          /invocations/stream)                │
│ --help                                   Show this message and exit.         │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
